In your messages, this chat looks only for a few words about safety and about its topics; it does not answer them, does not diagnose and does not replace a doctor. The chat is kept on this phone. What it notes for you goes where the app keeps such things: a symptom, a pain or your mood into your journal, a medicine into your medicines. You can open it and delete it there.

An AI model on this phone reads your messages.

An AI model on this phone reads your messages and chooses which of the app’s fixed questions and buttons to show. It can add one of the app’s fixed safety questions, never remove one; whether to seek help comes from your answers and the app’s fixed rules.

The model reads only the message you send and where the chat stands, never your journal, and it sends nothing anywhere. What it decided is kept with your message in the chat, so the chat reads the same each time it is opened; it goes wherever the chat goes — into backups and to a new phone, never into Health Connect — and deleting the chat deletes it from the app. The model learns nothing from what you write. It never words a question of its own, and nothing goes into your journal or your medicines without your tap.
